titles: She almost closed her bakery. Then her son searched one thing
Fifteen years of cakes, four sales a day
logline: A baker about to close after fifteen years finds out her shop simply doesn't exist when people search.
ask: Would you have found the real reason sooner?

cold.speaker: a
cold.line: Fifteen years. And I have to close it on Friday.

beats.speaker: b
beats.line: Mum, we sold four cakes today. Four.

beats.speaker: a
beats.line: People just don't buy cakes any more, love.

beats.speaker: c
beats.line: Best cake in town? I ordered from Sugar Lane last night.

beats.speaker: b
beats.line: Sugar Lane? They only opened last month!

beats.speaker: b
beats.line: Cake near me. Sugar Lane. Sugar Lane. Every single time.
